model.stratum: Complete retained construction records with the current labelled seed, gap, pairing, frame conventions and signed carrier recipes. Both operations reassemble coefficients from geometry; no map between compressed state vectors is claimed.
consumes: retained tetrahedral seed and assembly recipes
provides: six recipe comparisons and four triangular route checks
missing_constructors: derivation uniquely selecting the supplied recipe choices
model.next_falsifier: Either intermediate must match its entire retained protocol, and both final records must agree in geometry, signs, coordinates and every coefficient. Merely switching two labels or matching a return rank is insufficient.
